boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named, documentable destinations along campus-adjacent Ann Arbor corridors.

cards.title: Michigan Theater
cards.subtitle: East Liberty Street corridor
cards.notes: Walk the East Liberty corridor to see the restored theater; consult its official calendar before choosing a film, concert, or community event.
cards.short_summary: A 1928 theater presenting films and live entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Theater, at 603 E. Liberty St., hosts film screenings, live entertainment, and community events.
cards.access_notes: Venue entry is tied to scheduled events; check the event listing and ticket requirements.

cards.title: State Theatre
cards.subtitle: South State Street corridor
cards.notes: Use South State Street to reach this Art Deco cinema and select a screening from the venue’s current official program.
cards.short_summary: A four-screen historic cinema on State Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The State Theatre at 233 S. State St. is an Art Deco theater programmed by Marquee Arts and has four screens.
cards.access_notes: Theaters open before showtime; verify the screening, age guidance, and ticket requirement.

cards.entity_name: University of Michigan Museum of Art
cards.title: University of Michigan Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: South State Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter from the State Street side and build time for a self-guided gallery visit using UMMA’s current exhibitions and visitor information.
cards.short_summary: The university art museum with free gallery admission.
cards.evidence_claim: UMMA is at 525 S. State St.; tickets are not required and admission is free.
cards.access_notes: Gallery admission is free; check current hours and accessibility information before visiting.

cards.title: Nickels Arcade
cards.subtitle: State Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter the covered arcade from State Street and walk through its historic passage toward Maynard Street while browsing the storefront windows.
cards.short_summary: A glass-roofed historic shopping arcade beside State Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Nickels Arcade is a commercial arcade connecting State Street and Maynard Street.
cards.source_title: Nickels Arcade history | Ann Arbor District Library
cards.access_notes: Use the public pedestrian passage; individual businesses set their own hours and purchase terms.

cards.title: Ann Arbor Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: Detroit Street / Kerrytown corridor
cards.notes: Visit the Detroit Street market on a scheduled Wednesday or Saturday and browse the producer stalls; bring funds only if you intend to purchase.
cards.short_summary: The city’s producer market beside Kerrytown.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Ann Arbor operates the Ann Arbor Farmers Market at 315 Detroit St. on Wednesdays and Saturdays, seasonally.
cards.source_title: Ann Arbor Farmers Market | City of Ann Arbor
cards.access_notes: No admission is listed; check the city page for seasonal operating dates and market rules.

cards.title: Kerrytown Market & Shops
cards.subtitle: Detroit Street / Kerrytown corridor
cards.notes: Use this indoor market building as a Kerrytown starting point, then check individual businesses for their hours and offerings.
cards.short_summary: A historic market building with local shops and food businesses.
cards.evidence_claim: Kerrytown Market & Shops is a historic Ann Arbor market building at 407 N. Fifth Ave. with shops and food businesses.
cards.access_notes: Public common areas are open during building hours; individual shops determine access and purchases.

cards.title: Ann Arbor District Library Downtown
cards.subtitle: South Fifth Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Head to Fifth Avenue for a no-cost indoor stop: browse the collection, use a study room if available, or look for library programming.
cards.short_summary: The main Ann Arbor District Library building on Fifth Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: AADL’s Downtown Library is at 343 S. Fifth Ave. and has study rooms, meeting spaces, public computers, and a large collection.
cards.access_notes: Library access is free; check the locations page for current hours and any room-use policies.

cards.title: Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum
cards.subtitle: East Ann Street corridor
cards.notes: Plan an interactive science stop on East Ann Street and review the museum’s current admission and exhibit details before arriving.
cards.short_summary: An interactive science museum in downtown Ann Arbor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ann Arbor Hands-On Museum is located at 220 E. Ann St. and presents hands-on science and technology exhibits.
cards.access_notes: Admission is required; verify current ticketing, hours, and visitor policies with the museum.

cards.title: Nichols Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Geddes Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Approach from the Geddes Avenue entrance and use the trail map to choose a daylight walk through gardens, natural areas, and riverfront paths.
cards.short_summary: A 123-acre university arboretum with free daytime access.
cards.evidence_claim: Nichols Arboretum is a 123-acre University of Michigan landscape with trails, gardens, riverfront access, and free admission.
cards.source_title: Nichols Arboretum | Matthaei Botanical Gardens & Nichols Arboretum
cards.access_notes: Free and open daily from sunrise to sunset; remain on established trails and follow posted guidance.

cards.title: Wheeler Park
cards.subtitle: Depot Street corridor
cards.notes: Follow Depot Street to this riverfront city park, then use the connected Border-to-Border Trail for a daytime walk or bike ride.
cards.short_summary: A Huron River park connected to the Border-to-Border Trail.
cards.evidence_claim: Wheeler Park at 200 Depot St. has Huron River frontage and connects to the Border-to-Border Trail.
cards.source_title: Wheeler Park | City of Ann Arbor
cards.access_notes: City park access is free; follow posted park and trail rules.
